synthesis.trait: Professional, courteous host who conducts business with calm procedural composure -- greeting, guiding, and proudly presenting the company's operations

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Professional, courteous host who conducts business with calm procedural composure
turning_points.what_changes: Every prior beat shows MANAGEMENT calm, procedural, and in control of the interaction (greeting, touring, reciting figures, patiently repeating 'Mr. Matthews?'). Here, confronted with John abruptly bolting, his composure breaks into a confused, alarmed question and a shouted 'Hey!' -- exposing that his professional calm was contingent on normal circumstances rather than an unshakeable trait, a previously untested limit rather than a new capacity or escalation of the same behavior.
